Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's  effect to link a card that doesn't have ?

Card Q&A.a: It refers to when you have the specified card in the battle area or breeding area.
Card Q&A.q: What does "while you have (the specified card) on the field" mean, exactly?

Effect: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [Appmon] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] or [App Driver] trait among them to the hand. Trash the rest. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・You may link 1 card from your hand with 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
